title: Dutch regulator fines Uber €825M for letting AI deactivate driver accounts

reasonEn: The Dutch data protection authority fined Uber 825 million because the company's AI system deactivated driver accounts without proper human review. The case shows how automated decisions need supervision and transparency, and may become a reference for other companies using AI to make decisions that affect people's work.
